palette.name: sky-zenith
palette.role: derived deeper zenith above sky-high; the only non-world-palette tone

palette.name: cloud-shade
palette.role: horizon haze; the same tone shades the separate cloud sheet

palette.name: hill-dark
palette.role: distant wooded crests and near-hill folds

palette.name: leaf-dark
palette.role: far-bank woods, hedge shadows, fern beds

palette.name: grass-deep
palette.role: deepest grass, terrace shadows, HUD strip

palette.name: stone
palette.role: lit boulder facets and garden step stones

paletteNotes: 30 colours are used in the base. cloud (#f6f0da) and cream (#f7eccf) are deliberately NOT in the base because the landscape is cloudless; they live in clouds.png for the engine layer.
sky-low (#d7ebd8) and blush (#e8a39d) are unused; cloud-shade carries the horizon haze.
cloud-shade/foam and hill-dark/leaf-dark are near pairs; they occupy separate zones (sky haze vs water foam, distant crests vs near hedge) and never stack as adjacent flat steps.

hudSafeZone.note: plain dark grass; no painted plants below y181

sky.bands: four hand-shaped bands: zenith y0-~18, sky-high to ~40, sky-mid to ~80, horizon haze to ~86
sky.note: No sun, moon or clouds are painted. The base is a neutral late-morning sky; the engine supplies the celestial bodies, stars and drifting clouds.

hills.note: One quiet cool fold on the near hill face at x190-226 y99-105; no warm clearing patch.

water.shallowShelf: 2-4 px water-mid shallow hem around the shores, a wide water shelf on the left and a shallow bar across the lower deep; water-mid patches lighten the shelf

farReflection.note: dark reflection of the far woods in the upper water; longer under the flanking trees, short in the open middle

water.ripples: 11 clustered 3-5 px glint runs, none in the clear centre

clearCentre.note: kept free of bright highlights and painted lily pads so the engine reflections, ripples and pads read

lilyPadZone.note: engine-owned pads; no pads painted into the base

leftBank.terraces: three levels: upper flat y120-136 (lit leaf), mid flat y140-158, lower flat y166-179; short stone garden steps and dense fern/moss beds at the edges; 15 open planting pockets

mossyBoulder.note: exclude from planting hit tests; sits on the left mid terrace with a soft lower-left shadow

leftBank.reedBeds: x78-100, y128-178, at the water edge

rightBank.terraces: three levels: upper flat y120-136 with the skep, mid flat y140-158, lower flat y166-179; short stone steps and edge fern beds; 15 open planting pockets
rightBank.reedBeds: x254-280, y130-178, at the water edge

foregroundLip.note: thin dark near lip above the HUD strip

hive.note: weathered wooden skep on a cut stump, entirely on the right upper terrace; no bees painted

log.note: half-sunken, mossy; usable as a water-strider platform

composition.hintValidation: all 30 tested against waterPolygon, left/right plantablePolygon, boulder/hive/log bounds and the y<181 HUD limit; 0 failures

cloudLayer.note: The base is cloudless. Drift and tint the transparent sheet above the painted tops, clipped to skylinePolygon; keep the sun/moon lane clear as the engine moves the celestial body.

dynamicOverlays: sun and moon arcs, stars and cloud drift (engine, clipped to skylinePolygon)
time-of-day and rain grade over the whole base
bees and hive glow around the hive bounds
reflections, ripples and splash particles clipped to waterPolygon
planted flowers at plantingHints and on the plantable bank polygons
rendering: 1x PNG, integer nearest-neighbour scaling only (4x = 1440x900 approx.)
fully opaque; no alpha, no anti-aliasing, no gradients or blur
dithering limited to sky-band edges and one-pixel deep-water softenings
warm key from the upper right; cool teal shadows; highlights face up/right
hitTestNotes: clip ripples/reflections to waterPolygon; the irregular near edge follows nearShoreline
do not plant inside the hive, log or boulder bounds, or the 17 px HUD strip
the skylinePolygon is the sky region above the painted hills; use it to clip stars, moon and clouds
the visible banks are wider than the old 320 crop: left 0-100, right 282-352; the pond is deliberately narrower to make the terraces

authoringNotes: Repainted at 352x198 for the 24-hour-cycle build. The pond is narrower than a direct scale-up so both banks become three-step terraces with 15 open planting pockets each.
Cloudless base: no painted clouds, sun, moon, star or sunlight path; the engine supplies those layers from clouds.png and the celestial pass.
The banks use lit upper flats, shaded lower flats, short stone garden steps, fern/moss beds and stepping stones; reeds and cattails hold the water edge.
All 30 planting hints were machine-checked against the water polygon, bank polygons, props and HUD limit before hand-off.
No photo, generator or external bitmap was used; every mass and cluster is hand-placed in the composition builder.
